decisions.diagnosis: The VivaCity feed stops publishing zero slots and whole zero days for this zone from late June 2025 (and some zero days around New Year 2024/25), so absent slots on days the camera published are true zeros.
decisions.evidence: Before 2025-06-22 every published day has all 96 slots and low zones had many zero-total days (e.g. 1277: 84 of 216, 1323: 86 of 214, 1250: 110 of 211); afterwards almost no zero-total days are published (0-2 per direction) while a similar share of days is absent (1277 has 184 of 456 days), and from late Oct 2025 the partial days contain only non-zero slots (slots == nonzero_slots). The camera published some zone on every day of the record.

decisions.diagnosis: Episodes of night-time 'bicycles' in both directions of the New Line Rd road-lane zone, likely misclassification during night roadworks or similar, but there is no mechanism to separate them from real riders.
decisions.evidence: Night (21:00-05:00) bikes per week in 1264/1267 were 0-4 through June 2026, then 18/17 (wk 06-29), 51/53 (wk 07-06), 156/192 (wk 08-03), 33/22 (wk 08-31); 2026-08-06 01:00-01:45 recorded 12,18,15,6 northbound and 16,27,17,7 southbound at once; weekly totals 215/249 in wk 08-03 against about 20-40 usually; the mean per day rose from 3-6 to 8-15 in Aug-Sep 2026.

summary: One VivaCity camera (counter 317) with eight low-volume zones at Castle Hill Rd / New Line Rd. From late June 2025 the feed drops zero slots and whole zero days, so every site gets zero_fill over the whole record. Low days match heavy rain or heat; the unexplained night-time bursts in 2026 in the New Line Rd road zone (462), and briefly in 456, 461 and 463, are recorded as uncertain.
